ui.projectIndexWarning: Assignment saved; some artifact indexes could not be updated:
ui.noProjects: No projects yet. Create one by adding a conversation or continuing across conversations.
ui.deleteProjectDescription: Conversations return to history. Original artifacts stay in place, and the project directory retains its final text index.
ui.projectDescription: Conversations are grouped by their database project field. The artifact index records original paths; files are not moved or copied.
ui.permissionTiming: Saved permissions apply to subsequent tasks. Running tasks retain the permissions they started with.
ui.contextTimeout: Context detection timed out. It will retry when the task starts and use 131072 if detection fails.
ui.contextDescription: Uses 131072 if automatic detection fails. The compaction threshold reserves space for output and tool responses. Save to apply changes.
ui.installDefaultSkills: Install or restore default skills (Ponytail, Superpowers)
ui.speechConnected: Connection successful. Use the conversation microphone to verify recognition quality.
ui.speechDescription: The default is FunASR SenseVoiceSmall Q8 (about 242 MiB), loaded separately. Save to apply changes. Recognized text is placed in the composer for you to send. Local replacements require SenseVoice-compatible GGUF files; other engines use HTTP.
ui.terminalDescription: These settings apply to desktop terminals opened manually. The execution engine runs task commands in their session directories, using task permissions.
ui.themeDescription: Themes are application settings and are saved immediately. Follow the system or choose an installed theme. Workspaces do not store theme settings.
ui.deleteTodoConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this todo item?
ui.displayLanguageDescription: Choose the desktop display language and restart to apply it to the entire application.
ui.supplementalDescription: Custom JSON language packs supplement the conversation and settings interface. Use the display language above to translate the desktop shell.
ui.pushQueuedMessage: Jump the queue: run this one next
ui.pushQueuedMessageNow: Send to conversation: prioritize after the current step
